title: Repeated left moves of the input head
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $p$ be one of the $n+2$ input-head positions, and let $a\in\mathbb{N}$. After $a$ successive left moves, the head position is $p-a$, with subtraction understood in the natural numbers and hence truncated at zero.
hypotheses_covered: A position $p$ among the $n+2$ valid input-head positions
